title: What Svelte 5 changed, and the Svelte 4 code still out there

videos.script:
Svelte 5 came out in October 2024. {{date}} It changed how a component says almost everything: state, props, events, and the content passed into it.

The old way still runs. {{legacy}} Svelte 5 compiles Svelte 4 components, so projects can upgrade one file at a time. And that means most of the Svelte you will find online is Svelte 4.

So today you learn to read it. {{table}} First, a table: each idea, spelled the old way and the new way.

Then you run some. {{run}} The planner's week buttons become a Svelte 4 component, and the page uses it without noticing.

Then the bug that ended Svelte 4. {{bug}} A tidy refactoring that silently stops a label from updating, and why a rune does not have the problem.

Then the compiler migrates the component for you, {{migrate}} and you finish the two decisions it leaves.

And last, old SvelteKit code in a new project. {{old}} Two errors you will meet the day you paste an example from an old tutorial, and what each one is telling you.
